import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Radical
theorem p2_n001 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v0 ≤ p2v1)) : (p2v0 ≤ p2v0) := by
  exact @Preorder.le_refl Nat _ p2v0

theorem p2_n002 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v0 ≤ p2v1)) : (p2v0 = p2v0) := by
  exact @LE.le.antisymm Nat _ p2v0 p2v0 (p2_n001 p2v0 p2v1 h0) (p2_n001 p2v0 p2v1 h0)

theorem p2_n003 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v0 ≤ p2v1)) : (p2v0 ∣ p2v0) := by
  exact @dvd_refl Nat _ p2v0

theorem p2_n004 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v0 ≤ p2v1)) : (p2v0 ∣ 0) := by
  exact @dvd_zero Nat _ p2v0
